Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is my 3rd full size Weber gas grill in past 20 years. You can expect about 10 years out of a Weber with reasonable care using average twice a week all year. Previous ones had burners side to side, heated evenly but lost one side table due to side control knobs and the spark ignition always burnt out. NEW front to back burners gives me two side tables with controls in front, they  still provide even heat and we'll see about ignitor. They took away the full size ash tray and opted to use just the smaller ash catcher. We'll have to see how that works , should be OK but will have to check ash much  more frequently on this 210. NEW style seems to run hotter because with both burners on low my cooking temp is around 300 possibly due to more enclosed lower casting . Too high for chicken and slow cooking ribs. I have to turn off one side and use the other which cuts down on cooking space.  I chose the open lower style with no cabinet. My last one completely rusted out on the bottom shelf as I live in TN. and have very high humidity.
Results.Title: 4th Weber gas grill owner

Results.ReviewText: The Spirit II E-210 gas grill (sapphire blue color) that I purchased online from Weber was quickly delivered in a sturdy cardboard box to my home in September 2019.  After reviewing the included manual, I was able to easily assemble this grill in about 3 hours, followed by a preliminary shake-down run on my deck with a 20 minute heating cycle to about 550F, as indicated by the convenient built-in hood thermometer.  That evening, I put the grill to the test by cooking two filet Mignon steaks for my wife and me, and the results were excellent.  Since then, I have grilled chicken, hamburger patties (with buns), cod fish, and pork - all with great results.  I really appreciate the design features of the Spirit II.  I also like the beautiful appearance of this grill on my deck, and I love the ease of grilling food that tastes great.  I wish I had bought this grill much earlier.

Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.
